notes: The Dashboard is now just your daily view: progress, payoff timeline, logging a payment, your debts, and the ones you've beaten. It went from fourteen sections to six.

Planning tools moved to the Strategy tab, where they belong - your monthly budget, payment summary, cash-flow release, roadmap, lump sums, and the balance transfer modeller are now together in one place.
New Settings tab holds backup and restore, theme, premium status and the update check - things you set once, rather than clutter you scroll past every day.
Nothing was removed and none of your data or settings changed. Everything is still there, just somewhere more sensible.
